title: 云端AI都那么强了，为什么还要在本地部署大模型？
text:
Lately, the concept of the Agent has blown up,
and major P C makers have started pushing Agent P Cs.
But many folks have one genuine question,
Since web based, cloud based AI is already so powerful,
why are major PC makers pouring so much effort
into cramming large language model s onto local machines?
So, what irreplaceable uses does on device A I have?
With that question in mind,
I attended Intel’s twenty twenty six
Agent P C Application Sharing Conference.
After hearing the core logic and trying it myself,
I finally found the answer.
Turns out,
What on device A I aims to solve are two tall walls
that current cloud based large language models
just cannot surmount,
the first is the token cost wall.
Daily A I tasks like email drafting or text polishing
do not feel costly on the cloud.
But the future trend is, Agent P C.
We need A I to act like a real personal assistant,
on call twenty four sevenths say,
to watch the markets and analyze sentiment around the clock,
or to sum up a full day’s meetings in real time.
From one off Q and A's to continuous,
high frequency monitoring,
cloud TOKEN use skyrockets exponentially.
Such hefty, ongoing call
fees are simply unaffordable for regular folks
and S M E's.
The second wall, privacy, security.
Many high value A I use cases involve highly sensitive data
say, a firm’s key
financial reports and confidential contracts,
or your own private photos and chat logs.
Would you truly feel safe uploading all these core assets
to a third party cloud server?
Once data leaves your local device,
the risk of leakage is ever present.
Owing to its cost and risks,
cloud based A I struggles to penetrate core workflows.
This means on device A I is no mere stopgap
but the future's only choice.
To tackle these two pain points,
Intel, at this recent sharing session,
laid out a clear, foundational solution,
Edge Cloud Collaboration plus model routing.
Simply put: stop mindlessly tossing all problems to the cloud
and instead, set clear roles.
All those frequent, routine tasks you do,
or any sensitive, private files
your P C’s local computing power handles them all.
Only for those super complex tasks
that demand high level logical reasoning.
the Agent will first mask and anonymize
your private data locally,
then send that secure query off to the cloud for computation.
This assign tasks to whoever is best for them
mechanism is what is called Super Claw model routing
and it needs no manual switching from you.
The system will auto judge task difficulty
and match you with the best computing resources.
But this begs a new question:
can a local PC’s compute power
truly run such a massive large language model ?
And that brings us to Intel’s push on underlying hardware.
At this showcase, Intel spotlighted its Intel Core Ultra Series three processor.
To break past the hardware bottleneck of insufficient RAM,
they teamed up with storage firms
like Phison Electronics Corp.
to develop a tech dubbed MoE expert offloading.
To put it simply,
it uses the AI SSD’s intelligent prefetching
to stash some model parameters not in use right now
onto that high speed Solid State Drive .
This lets a regular thirty two gigabytes
R A M thin and light laptop
run a thirty five B parameter
large language model smoothly.
Plus, paired with the N P U's ultra low power standby ability,
running on device A I around the clock becomes a reality.
With that solid base of underlying hardware,
China’s top software firms
have turned this Edge Cloud Collaboration concept
into tangible productivity tools.
For instance, Tencent's Marvis
can sort your P C files using just its local model,
even offline.
That same firm’s QClaw assistant,
when helping you analyze confidential files,
it first locally anonymizes sensitive info
like names and salaries.
Only then is it sent to the cloud for a report,
ensuring all secrets stay local.
honor's yoyo claw
A I agent can proactively gauge your intents
and offer tailored services.
by deeply tapping into Intel’s local compute power to run
tons of daily tasks locally, slashing cloud hosting costs
by a hefty seventy percent.
And for boosting efficiency,
Remio uses the local N P U and G P U
to index dozens of P D F pages
in a flash, without burning a single bit of compute power.
These apps from major firms all prove one thing,
using local compute power
not only quells all security worries,
but also slashes the marginal cost of use down to zero.
Beyond helping you handle work and boost productivity,
on device
A I can also cater perfectly to your life and leisure.
Right now, for the twenty twenty six
US Canada Mexico World Cup,
due to time zones, many great matches
air in the dead of night—making it tough for working folks
to stay up late nightly to watch.
This Soccer Fan Agent, co launched by Intel and Flowy A I P C,
comes in super handy!
It lets A I stay up late
for you to watch the whole live match
and automatically logs all the game’s highlights.
It is simple, just open the Flowy A I P C client,
head to the Intel Zone in the Agent Store,
and one click install the A I kanqiu Assistant.
It can not only record and clip live events in real time,
but also lets you pre book matches that have not started yet.
it can even handle missed post game replays,
ensuring you catch every single match!
From the event list,
just pick any match you wish to watch,
tap Schedule A I powered match viewing,
and let your P C handle the rest!
At night, just sleep soundly;
leave your PC on,
and a small PiP window will pop up as the game plays.
Note, the P C cannot be muted,
since the A I needs to snag audio cues in sync.
but you can dim the screen,
and by next morning, you will get the video clips
the A I cut for you locally last night.
The system even auto generates
text analyses—goals and call details,
all at a glance.
While others stay up, their eyes all red, dozing off by day,
you just spend five minutes in the morning
and catch all the game’s highlights!
Most importantly, this whole process
understanding hours of video streams,
editing clips, and pushing notifications
relies entirely on your local machine.
This P C’s local compute power
incurred zero extra cloud service fees.
Before, we had to learn how to use software,
now, agents proactively vie to do tasks for us
this marks the true Agent P C era.
Thanks to Intel’s powerful underlying compute
and improving local software,
A I is no longer just a chat webpage
it is become our most reliable work buddy!
Number wasted cash, and total secrecy!
Soon, everyone will have a free, private digital team
and it all kicks off with this Agent P C on your desk.
